operators.name: custom_mean

parameters.name: x
parameters.layout: contiguous or strided, must support input strides

semantics: Computes mean over dimension 1 with keepdim=True, matching torch.mean(x, dim=1, keepdim=True).
Reduction axis is features (size 1024); output element at [b,0,h,w] = sum_f x[b,f,h,w] / features.
No bias or other affine transformation.

operators.name: custom_layer_norm

parameters.name: x
parameters.layout: contiguous or strided, must support input strides

semantics: Applies LayerNorm over the last three dimensions (1, height, width) as specified by normalized_shape.
No weight or bias: y = (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps) with eps=1e-5.
Mean and variance are computed over dims (1,2,3) for each batch item.
Computes mean over dimension 1 while keeping the dimension, reducing [1024,1024,32,32] to [1024,1,32,32].
Applies layer normalization over normalized_shape (1,32,32) on the mean tensor from step_001. No affine parameters.
